boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Manhattan University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe restaurant stops in Riverdale and nearby Bronx with currently published late hours.

cards.title: Tex’s Chicken & Burgers
cards.subtitle: 32 E Kingsbridge Rd, Bronx
cards.notes: Use the official location page to check the day’s schedule, then place a pickup or delivery order if its late closing window fits your plans.
cards.short_summary: A Kingsbridge food stop with the latest published hours in this set.
cards.evidence_claim: Tex’s lists this Bronx location at 32 E Kingsbridge Rd and publishes hours until 3 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists 10 a.m.–3 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 10 a.m.–4 a.m. Friday–Saturday; pickup and delivery are offered.

cards.title: El Mangu Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 80 W Kingsbridge Rd, Bronx
cards.notes: Check whether weekday or weekend hours apply, then use the restaurant’s order flow for carryout or delivery from West Kingsbridge Road.
cards.short_summary: A nearby Latin American restaurant with published service through late evening or midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: El Mangu’s official site lists 80 W Kingsbridge Rd and business hours until 11 p.m. Monday–Thursday and midnight Friday–Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists 7 a.m.–11 p.m. Monday–Thursday and 7 a.m.–midnight Friday–Sunday; it offers carryout or delivery ordering.

cards.title: Caridad Kingsbridge
cards.subtitle: 135 W Kingsbridge Rd, Bronx
cards.notes: Confirm the day’s posted closing time before heading out, and choose dine-in or takeaway from the restaurant’s published options.
cards.short_summary: A Kingsbridge restaurant whose posted hours extend to midnight most days.
cards.evidence_claim: Caridad Kingsbridge lists 135 W Kingsbridge Rd and publishes opening hours until midnight Sunday–Friday and 1 a.m. Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists dine-in or takeaway hours of 7 a.m.–midnight Sunday–Friday and 7 a.m.–1 a.m. Saturday.

cards.title: Metate Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 3515 Johnson Ave, Riverdale
cards.notes: Plan around the specific day’s closing time, then use the restaurant’s listed delivery and takeout option for a food-focused evening stop.
cards.short_summary: A Riverdale Mexican restaurant with late published dinner hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Metate’s official site lists 3515 Johnson Ave and regular hours until 11 p.m. Monday–Thursday, midnight Friday and Saturday, and 10 p.m. Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official site publishes regular service until 11 p.m. Monday–Thursday, midnight Friday–Saturday, and 10 p.m. Sunday; delivery and takeout are listed.

cards.title: Wendy’s on Broadway
cards.subtitle: 5805 Broadway, Bronx
cards.notes: Use the official restaurant-hours table before leaving; it distinguishes the extended Friday and Saturday schedule from the rest of the week.
cards.short_summary: A Broadway fast-food location with consistently late official hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s publishes this restaurant at 5805 Broadway with hours until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4:59 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists restaurant hours through 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4:59 a.m. Friday–Saturday; holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Arturo’s Pizza
cards.subtitle: 5189 Broadway, Bronx
cards.notes: Check the shop’s current online ordering status, then order ahead for pickup from its Broadway address before the posted midnight close.
cards.short_summary: A neighborhood pizza shop publishing a midnight closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: Arturo’s Pizza identifies its location as 5189 Broadway in the Bronx and displays hours of 10:30 a.m.–midnight.
cards.access_notes: Official site displays 10:30 a.m.–12 a.m. and offers online ordering; verify availability before travel.

cards.title: Fei Thai Hibachi Sushi
cards.subtitle: 438 W 238th St, Bronx
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s dinner schedule to time a food order; closing varies by day, including later Friday and Saturday service.
cards.short_summary: A West 238th Street restaurant with documented late-week dinner hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Fei Thai Hibachi Sushi lists 438 W 238th St and dinner through 10 p.m. Friday and Saturday, with 9:30 p.m. closing Monday and Wednesday–Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists dinner until 9:30 p.m. Monday and Wednesday–Thursday, 10 p.m. Friday and Saturday, and 9 p.m. Sunday; closed Tuesday.

cards.title: Oaxaqueño Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 155 W Kingsbridge Rd, Bronx
cards.notes: Check the restaurant’s official business-hours panel, then use its online ordering link if a food pickup or delivery fits your evening.
cards.short_summary: A Mexican restaurant with the same late-evening hours published every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Oaxaqueño Restaurant lists 155 W Kingsbridge Rd and publishes daily business hours from 9:30 a.m. to 9:45 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists daily hours of 9:30 a.m.–9:45 p.m. and provides an online ordering link.

cards.title: Bokagua Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 3541 Riverdale Ave, Bronx
cards.notes: Review the restaurant’s ordering page for the day’s split or evening service, then arrange pickup or delivery before its listed 10:30 p.m. close.
cards.short_summary: A Riverdale Avenue restaurant with evening service shown through 10:30 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Bokagua Restaurant’s official ordering page lists 3541 Riverdale Ave and service until 10:30 p.m. Sunday–Thursday.
cards.access_notes: The restaurant’s official Toast ordering page lists Sunday 5:30–10:30 p.m. and Monday–Thursday 5–10:30 p.m.; Friday and Saturday are shown closed.

cards.title: Aroma Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 5523 Broadway, Bronx
cards.notes: Consult Aroma’s daily-hours listing before a dinner visit, and use the food menu or reservation contact when the late schedule suits your plans.
cards.short_summary: A Broadway restaurant that publishes nightly service through 11 p.m. or midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Aroma Restaurant lists 5523 Broadway and is open daily until midnight, with its official schedule showing 11 p.m. Monday–Thursday and midnight Friday–Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists 12 p.m.–11 p.m. Monday–Thursday and 12 p.m.–midnight Friday–Sunday; confirm service details directly before travel.
